'''Yuv Kal Zaer''' was a member of a [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] that dominated [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] through scientific advancement<ref name="Codex" /> [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Remote">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Iokath Remotes}}</ref> Holding the title of lead design analyst, Zaer composed a report about the [[Invasion of test environment JX967A24|deployment]] of a weapons project against a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] cataloged as [[test environment JX967A24]]; the deployment was far more successful than the past three weapons tests, leading Zaer to laud the work of the project's [[master designer]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yuv Kal Zaer was mentioned in the Codex entry "History of Iokath: Entry 1" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']],<ref name="Codex" /> the [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Launch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161202-1|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Now Live!}}</ref>
